meta.title: FadeUp — Find the barber who gets your cut
meta.description: Search real barbershops and independent barbers near you. See who is open, book a time, or join the live queue from your phone.

hero.subtitle: Search the barbers actually on FadeUp. See who is open, book a time, or take a place in the queue from your phone.

discover.title: Real chairs. Real people.
discover.body: Every barber here runs their day on FadeUp, so what you see is what is genuinely open.
discover.emptyTitle: FadeUp is opening city by city.
discover.emptyBody: Search yours to see which barbers are already here.

book.title: Book a time. Or just walk in.

appointment.label: Appointment
appointment.title: Pick your slot
appointment.body: Choose your barber and a time that suits you. The chair is held.

queue.label: Live queue
queue.title: Join from your phone
queue.body: Walk-in shops run a live queue. Take a place, watch it move, and arrive when you are close.

passport.title: FadeUp remembers your cut.
passport.body: The number, the length, the beard line, the barber who got it right. It is yours, and it travels with you — even to a shop you have never sat in.

rebook.title: It gets better the second time.
rebook.body: No explaining it again. No starting over. Your barber already knows.

final.title: Find your barber.
final.subtitle: Search by city, shop, barber or service.

meta.title: FadeUp for barbers — run the whole shop
meta.description: Appointments, walk-ins, the live queue, chairs and customers in one system built for barbers. Independent, one shop or several — pick your setup and watch FadeUp become it.

modes.groupLabel: Choose the kind of business you run

today.title: Your day, already laid out.
today.body: Open the shop and the whole day is on one screen — every booking, every barber, in the order they happen.

independent.title: Your day, on one screen.
independent.body: Open the app and today is already there: who is coming, when, and what for. Nothing to set up first.

multi_location.title: Every shop, one morning.
multi_location.body: See both floors at once, then drop into either one without changing accounts.

appointments.title: A slot fills itself.
appointments.body: Someone picks a service, a barber and a time. It lands in the day, and the chair is held.

walkins.title: Your shop is not only appointments.
walkins.body: Somebody comes in without a booking. They choose a service and a barber — or whoever is next free.

independent.title: Not everyone books ahead.
independent.body: Somebody knocks between appointments. Take them in without losing the rest of your day.

queue.title: Walk in. Don't wait around.
queue.body: They take a place from their phone and watch it move. Nobody stands by the door asking how long.

barber.title: The chair that frees up first.
barber.body: The queue hands the customer to the barber they asked for, or to whoever is next available.

independent.title: There is only one chair.
independent.body: Nothing to assign. The queue is yours, and the next person in it is yours.

chair.title: FadeUp works while you work.
chair.body: Who is in the chair, what they asked for, what you did last time. Finish, and the next one is already there.

passport.title: Remember the cut.
passport.body: The guard, the length, the beard line. The customer owns it and it travels with them, so the second visit starts where the first one ended.

history.title: Turn a cut into a regular.
history.body: Every visit lands on the same record. Last service, usual barber, how long since — there without asking them.

retention.title: Pro is what brings them back.
retention.body: Passport is how FadeUp remembers a customer. Working out who is overdue and reaching them before they drift is the Retention Suite — Pro-level, and not built yet. We would rather tell you here than sell it to you today.

control.title: Today first. Settings after.
control.body: What is happening now sits at the top. Everything you configure is there when you need it and out of the way when you don't.

independent.title: Your book, your rules.
independent.body: Your hours, your services, your prices. Change them in the morning and the change is live.

multi_location.title: Every floor, one console.
multi_location.body: Locations, teams, queues and chairs — one shop at a time, or all of them.

team.title: Your barbers, your chairs, your rules.
team.body: Invite barbers, reception and managers. Set what each of them can do, and put them where they actually work.

multi_location.title: A team per shop.
multi_location.body: Invite people into a specific location, and let a manager run their own floor without seeing everyone else's.

marketplace.title: Meet the next ones.
marketplace.body: Your shop and every barber in it get a public profile. Same chairs, same services — now findable.

independent.title: Your profile is the shop.
independent.body: One public page with your services, your hours and your work. That is the storefront.

discovery.title: Found by city, service or name.
discovery.body: Customers search FadeUp for a barber near them. Published shops are what they find — nothing else is listed.

rebook.title: Back in the chair.
rebook.body: Same barber, same cut, one tap. The booking lands in today, and the day starts over.

loop.title: One system. From discovery to the next cut.
loop.body: Not a calendar with extras bolted on. Every step feeds the next one.

existing.title: Good. Your calendar is already digital.
existing.body: That was the easy part. What most booking tools do not touch is everything that happens after someone walks through the door.
existing.note: Bring your appointments across by hand or start fresh — there is no automatic import today, and we will not pretend otherwise.

pricing.title: Pay for the shop you actually run.

for.independent: One plan, for one barber. Everything you need to be found, booked and remembered.
for.barbershop: Three levels for a single-location shop. Start where you are, move when the floor asks for it.
for.multi_location: Three levels for a business running more than one shop.

pricing.taxNote: Shown for your region, excluding tax. Billing is not live yet — joining starts an application, not a charge.
pricing.passportEveryPlan: In every plan, always. Never an upgrade.
pricing.retentionComingToPlan: Packaged with this plan. Not built yet — you will not be billed for it before it ships.
pricing.retentionNotInPlan: Pro and above. Not in this plan.
pricing.applicationNote: Joining sends an application. A person reviews it — no card, no charge.

solo.name: Solo
solo.body: The whole FadeUp product, sized for someone working alone. A public profile people can find, a booking page, walk-ins, a live queue and Fade Passport — without a single screen about managing staff.

shop_essential.name: Essential
shop_essential.body: Everything a modern barbershop needs to take bookings and keep its customers: public profiles for the shop and every barber, services, availability, walk-ins, a team, and Fade Passport.

shop_pro.name: Pro
shop_pro.positioning: Run it live, and bring them back
shop_pro.body: Everything in Essential, plus the floor running live: the queue, the in-shop screen, chairs and the waitlist. This is the plan the rest of this page was describing.

shop_business.name: Business
shop_business.body: Everything in Pro, plus the deeper controls a busy single-location shop asks for once several people are running it.

multi_growth.name: Growth
multi_growth.body: Several locations under one business. Teams, services, queues and chairs per shop, and one place to see them all.

multi_pro.name: Pro
multi_pro.body: Everything in Growth, and customer retention across the whole group rather than one shop at a time.

multi_scale.name: Scale
multi_scale.body: Everything in Multi Pro, plus the centralised configuration and reporting a larger group needs.

compare.caption: Feature comparison across FadeUp plans
compare.plannedNote: "Coming" means the capability is packaged with the plan but is not built yet. It is not part of what you get today.
